protocol_contents.purpose: Fill the missing official full-history FP8 KV strong-baseline development comparison, not a candidate contribution or formal noninferiority test.
protocol_contents.prerequisite: Confirmation numerical/trajectory contract passed and run_jobs clean exit=0; first timeout remains failed and charged separately.
protocol_contents.procedure: One-token dense anchor then TWO-token all-question stochastic warmup to execute a real B3 decode before timing; then two separately reset APC cold anchor + together-admitted natural question groups. Each anchor must have zero cached tokens. No forced tokens or fixed measured output lengths.

metrics.primary: Per-document complete cold anchor + natural group wall, strict FINAL and fixed rounding with all three questions as denominator; report repeats individually and their median only when A/A tokens/steps match.
metrics.cost_accounting: CPU tokenizer/input prep, model initialization/JIT/warmup, prefix reset, audit exports and process allocation are retained separately. No claims that summed disjoint phases are a measured integrated client latency.
metrics.AA: Token ids, cache hits and batch/question/position sequences compared. Any mismatch remains in results; do not average as repeated identical work or select a faster repeat.
metrics.memory: Same .80 GPU pool fraction and limits. Report actual cache bytes/blocks/token capacity and allocated/reserved peaks; FP8 does not imply half of process allocated VRAM.
metrics.precision: Both arms official FP8 weights, BF16 compute/Q. FP8 KV loader default unit scalar each layer, checked tensor and host float. No calibration or hidden weights change.
metrics.quality: Frozen metric scripts. EOS/cap/parse failure retained; no output-length-normalized task speedup, no six-question formal statistical claims.
metrics.sampling_defaults: Explicitly preserve earlier native-vLLM SamplingParams defaults: top_k=0 (disabled), min_p=0, repetition_penalty=1. Model generation_config top_k=20 is not inherited when explicit SamplingParams are supplied; input_processor only merges EOS ids. Do not claim identity with earlier HF/application screens that explicitly used top_k20.
metrics.instrumentation: Native attention and graph math unchanged. CPU scheduler admission tokens are hashed before original add_requests; the graph wrapper asserts all request identities already mapped, preventing old GPU prompt readback. Hashing and per-step CPU metadata remain charged and are separately described. No Q/O/logit copies.
metrics.GPU_assignment: All pairs within a NUMA node (NODE topology): original BF16 0/1, original FP8 2/3; new FP8 4/5, new BF16 6/7. Same dtype on different nodes and reversed pair order across documents. No clock/power setting changes. Device pair remains confounded within document; timings descriptive, no causal small precision-effect claim or automatic crossover.
metrics.concurrent_startup: Four model loads contend for CPU/disk; retain initialization as observed concurrent setup, not isolated initialization cost.
metrics.cross_precision_APC: Compare per-question APC hits between BF16 and FP8 for each document/repeat; differences disallow interpreting timings as matched prefix-cache work.
metrics.anchor: q0 complete prompt with a discarded one-token answer; not pure document prefill. Cold means reset APC in a warmed engine.

limitations: Two previously used development documents, six natural questions and one seed; no formal evaluation or quality noninferiority conclusion.
Different KV precision may change model outputs and generation length. Report time and quality jointly; JCT or token/s ratios do not isolate executor speed.
FP8 scales are uncalibrated official defaults, not calibrated FP8, and this is an established baseline rather than a novel method.
Native attention and graphs remain unchanged. Minimal inherited CPU step metadata hooks remain charged; there are no Q/logit shadow copies.
Initial GPU assignment is not a cross-device replication. A later decision on repetition must follow this bounded pilot and preserve all results.
protocol_contents.CPU_validation: CPU admission identity test passed: reordered requests and resumed output suffix mapping, unknown prompt/request rejected before inherited graph callback; independent source review confirms add_requests ordering and data semantics.
